scheme_name: Scholarship For Cadets Of Sainik School Imphal
description:
The Scholarship for Cadets of Sainik School Imphal is a government initiative aimed at providing financial assistance to students enrolled in Sainik School Imphal, located in Manipur, India. 

Sainik Schools were established in India to prepare students for entry into the National Defence Academy and other military academies. 

The Sainik School Imphal was inaugurated on 21st July 2006. 

The primary objective of the scholarship scheme is to alleviate the financial burden on the parents of cadets. 

The scheme aims to ensure that deserving students have access to quality education without the hindrance of financial constraints. 

The scholarship provides a substantial amount of financial aid to eligible cadets. 

As of the current academic year, the scholarship amount is set at ₹20,000 per annum. 

This amount is intended to cover various educational expenses including tuition fees, books, and other necessary materials. 

The scholarship is available to students from economically weaker sections of society. 

Eligibility for the scholarship is primarily based on the income of the parents or guardians of the cadets. 

The annual income limit for eligibility is set at ₹1,50,000. 

This income criterion ensures that the scholarship reaches those who need it the most. 

In addition to the income criteria, applicants must be enrolled as cadets in Sainik School Imphal. 

The scholarship is applicable for students from Class VI to Class XII. 

The application process for the scholarship is straightforward. 

Interested candidates must obtain the scholarship application form from the school office or the official website of Sainik School Imphal. 

The application form must be filled out completely and accurately. 

Applicants are required to submit the form along with necessary documents. 

These documents include proof of income such as an income certificate issued by a competent authority. 

Additionally, applicants must provide a copy of their admission letter to Sainik School Imphal. 

A recent passport-sized photograph must also be attached to the application form. 

Once the application is completed, it should be submitted to the school office. 

The deadline for submission of applications is typically set at the beginning of the academic year. 

For the current academic year, the deadline for submission is 30th June. 

After the application deadline, the school administration reviews all applications. 

The selection process is based on the eligibility criteria and the completeness of the application. 

Successful candidates are notified of their selection through official communication from the school. 

The scholarship amount is disbursed directly to the bank accounts of the selected cadets. 

Disbursement typically occurs within one month of the selection announcement. 

The scholarship is renewable every year, provided the cadet maintains satisfactory academic performance. 

Cadets must achieve a minimum of 60% in their examinations to retain the scholarship. 

The implementing authority for this scholarship scheme is the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. 

The Sainik School Society oversees the administration of all Sainik Schools, including Sainik School Imphal. 

For any inquiries regarding the scholarship, parents and guardians can contact the school administration directly. 

The contact number for Sainik School Imphal is +91-385-244-1374. 

The official email address for inquiries is sainikschoolimphal@gmail.com. 

The school is located at Sainik School Imphal, Manipur, India. 

The scheme aims to promote the spirit of patriotism and discipline among young students. 

It encourages cadets to aspire for a career in the armed forces. 

The scholarship also aims to foster an environment of academic excellence. 

By providing financial support, the scheme helps to reduce dropout rates among students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. 

The initiative is part of a broader effort by the Indian government to enhance educational opportunities for all. 

The Sainik School Imphal has been instrumental in shaping the future of many young individuals. 

The school focuses not only on academic excellence but also on character building and leadership skills. 

The scholarship scheme plays a crucial role in ensuring that talented students can pursue their dreams without financial hindrance. 

In recent years, the number of applicants for the scholarship has increased significantly. 

This reflects the growing awareness of the opportunities provided by Sainik Schools. 

The government continues to evaluate and enhance the scholarship scheme to ensure its effectiveness. 

Regular assessments are conducted to determine the impact of the scholarship on student performance. 

The scholarship for cadets of Sainik School Imphal is a vital component of the educational framework in India. 

It aligns with the government's vision of inclusive education and social equity. 

The scheme not only supports individual students but also contributes to the overall development of the nation. 

By investing in the education of young minds, the government is laying the foundation for a stronger and more capable future. 

The scholarship serves as a beacon of hope for many families striving for better educational opportunities for their children. 

In conclusion, the Scholarship for Cadets of Sainik School Imphal is a well-structured initiative aimed at promoting education among economically weaker sections. 

It provides significant financial assistance to deserving students and encourages them to pursue careers in the armed forces. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to fostering talent and ensuring that no child is left behind in the pursuit of quality education.
